name: Roachdown
summary:
Roachdown is a casual VR shooter set in a grimy abandoned kitchen at night, where the roaches have taken over and you're the last line of defense.
Grab two pistols, blast anything that crawls or flies, and shake your gun in the air to reload,  no clip management, no menus, no fumbling. Just point, squeeze, and shake when empty.
You start slow. A few harmless roaches wander across the floor while you get your bearings. Then the attackers come — scuttling toward you, leaping up, taking flight, hovering around
